high_level_description: The Central Library of the UNAM university in Mexico City, a tall windowless block covered with colourful stone mosaics, with students on the green lawn in front.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A wide green lawn and pale paved plaza under a clear blue sky, with volcanic stone walls.

elements.desc: A tall rectangular library tower whose four walls are covered in a mosaic of coloured stones in ochre, red, blue and green forming abstract figures and symbols, with a band of windows at its base.
A cheerful young woman of about twenty-two with long dark hair and a denim jacket, waving with a folder under her arm.
A wide lawn with students sitting on the grass with books.
A dark volcanic stone wall with a few small cacti.
